title: Astrocytes are direct cellular targets of lithium treatment: novel roles for lysyl oxidase and peroxisome-proliferator activated receptor-γ as astroglial targets of lithium.

actual_arms.name: lithium chloride
actual_arms.exposure: 20 mM nominal culture condition for3days; Sigma Aldrich; catalog/purity not specified
actual_arms.control: Control medium in paper; saline-labelled controls in GEO; no explicit equiosmolar chloride comparator described
actual_arms.result: Increased GFAP-EGFP-positive cell counts and induced polarised long smooth processes/palisades; bulk Bub1b RNA signals lower.

actual_arms.name: β-aminopropionitrile (BAPN)
actual_arms.exposure: 3days; concentration not reported in reviewed main/captions/supplements
actual_arms.result: Similar morphology and increased reporter-positive counts; Fig4E one-star control bracket, whose threshold is not defined in the caption.

actual_arms.name: pioglitazone
actual_arms.result: Increased reporter counts; Fig4E ** control bracket per caption p<0.01; no head-to-head equivalence test against lithium.

actual_arms.name: 3-prime-O-methylepicatechin
actual_arms.role: actual flavonoid preparation per Results, Fig4 and caption
actual_arms.exposure: Methods calls it 3-O-Epicatechin at3micromolar; Results/caption/image specify methyl derivative;3days; identity wording conflict remains
actual_arms.result: Increased reporter counts; Fig4E *** control bracket p<0.001; no inheritance by dietary epicatechin or ordinary catechin.

model.setting: Adult mouse optic nerve with attached retina, organotypic ex-vivo culture; healthy background tissue, not a BUB1B-deficient or psychiatric disease model.
model.randomization_blinding: Group allocation not blinded; outcome measures said blinded; no excluded samples. Random assignment method not specified.

phenotypic_evidence.Fig1C: Author reports approximately doubled cell counts; native graph visually about21 versus38 cells/FOV, not digitized; p<0.001, unpaired/Student t-test, meanSEM.
phenotypic_evidence.FOV: 200x200micrometers in-plane and25micrometers depth, starting15micrometers below pia; one mid-nerve field per nerve.
phenotypic_evidence.what_was_measured: GFAP-EGFP reporter-positive counts and confocal morphology.
phenotypic_evidence.proliferation_limit: Authors call it proliferation; no BrdU/EdU/Ki67, division tracking or independent birth/death assay in reviewed study. Increased counts do not separate proliferation, survival or reporter detectability.
phenotypic_evidence.function_limit: No neuronal electrophysiology, synaptic support, axonal conduction, motor/cognitive behavior, injury rescue or BUB1B-deficient functional assay. The neuron-supportive phenotype is an interpretation, not directly tested function.

bub1b_evidence.main: Bub1b is central in a computational cell-cycle network in Fig1Hi; BUB1 is a distinct node. Node colour/enrichment P does not establish gene expression direction or protein abundance.
bub1b_evidence.supplement: Nine top-ranked genes do not include Bub1b; absence from this selected table is not a null experiment.
bub1b_evidence.measured_level: Bulk optic-nerve RNA microarray; astrocyte-associated gene-list intersection, not sorted-cell expression.
bub1b_evidence.direction: All3 exact-symbol probe sets have lower MAS5.0 signals in all4 lithium arrays than all4 control arrays.
bub1b_evidence.inferential_status: No between-group gene-specific differential-expression P/FDR assigned or recomputed. Native per-sample detection P values are available and retained separately; they are not treatment-effect tests. The original gene-filter/normalization pipeline is not reproduced.
bub1b_evidence.protein_stability_function: Not assayed; no restoration or checkpoint-harm inference.
bub1b_evidence.detection_limit: One probe is absent in every array; another has one absent lithium call; the third is present in every array. Retain all features without treating three probes as three independent studies or detection P as DE P/FDR. Lower processed probe signals are not a validated RNA-abundance decrease.

exposure_limit.authors_claim: Pia permeability reduces intranerve exposure to1–2mM, citing prior work.
exposure_limit.what_verified: This paper and supplements provide no measured tissue lithium concentration or human exposure bridge. Prior cited dose-response/PK paper not independently read here.
